title: NBA: Wemby's 50 leads Spurs win while Embiid sparks Sixers
summary: Victor Wembanyama scored 50 points and grabbed 19 rebounds to power San Antonio over New Orleans 114-91 on Saturday as the Spurs matched the NBA's best record at 14-3.
